landing.title: A table waiting for you
landing.askBody: Each restaurant has its own booking link, and this page is not one of them. Ask the restaurant for the link on WhatsApp, or look for it on their social media.
landing.step1Body: You see the restaurant’s real availability and choose the slot that works for you.
landing.step2Body: Your name, a phone number if you like, and any allergies or notes we should know.
landing.step3Body: The table is held right away. No accounts, no passwords, no waiting.
landing.footnote: Booking is free for guests and does not require an account.

notFound.title: This page doesn’t exist

orgNotFound.title: We couldn’t find this restaurant
orgNotFound.body: The link may be incomplete or may have changed. Ask the restaurant to share it again.
